Thank you for your work.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to find the cargo convoy and the ambush spot on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. The convoy is located between the LexOs car dealership and the Pinewood hotel. The ambush spot is an area that reaches from the green container with the [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher|AGS-30 grenade launcher]] behind the car dealership to the northeastern part of the car dealership. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with [[Claymores]].
